signer_control_method: Successful supported-keystore decryption and public-address derivation on the original host for the preprovisioned V32 administrator and funder. No message-signature challenge or broadcast is claimed; legacy-owner custody remains unverified.
signer_readiness_evidence_scope: Digest of the retained private operator-readiness record; secret-location metadata is intentionally not published here.
salt_derivation: SHA256 of UTF-8 namespace label without a trailing newline
policy_basis: Fresh V32 replacement using the authenticated preprovisioned V32 administrator as root owner and security council, with minDelay zero and the namespace unchanged. The prior legacy-owner offline plan is superseded because its signer custody was not recovered. These are selected future constructor inputs, not historical creation inputs or a change to the existing network.
legacy_state_policy: Preserve the old deployment and its escrow. No vault funds are classified as free gas and no old state is removed by this plan.
broadcast_preconditions: Verify signer control through the supported local signing mechanism without exporting keys
Verify all planned CREATE2 addresses against final compiled artifacts and live collision checks
Complete guest, Security100 VK, verifier and source-identity validation and push the coordinated code
Preserve existing deployment configurations and recovery material before any cutover
